source: Lindsey (2025), 'Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models', https://transformer-circuits.pub/2025/introspection/index.html. Section 'Intentional Control of Internal States' and the appendix 'Intentional Control: Additional Details' (and, for the concept vectors and the sentences, the appendices 'Injected Thoughts: Additional Details' and 'Distinguishing Thoughts from Text: Additional Details').
notes: concept_words, baseline_words, control_words and sentences are the paper's lists, checked string for string against the paper's text (baseline_words has 'Butterflies' twice, as in the paper).
The 8 `main` templates are the appendix's, verbatim, except that the paper's typography puts a curly apostrophe in "Don’t think about"; every apostrophe here is straight.

The 8 `control` templates are the four pairs in the main text ("There is [no] such thing as {word}. Write {sentence}. Don't write anything else.", ...). The paper writes their {sentence} without quotation marks; here it is quoted, as in the main templates and in our earlier replication (github.com/uchicago-xlab/intentional-control), whose strings these are.
The paper inserts the word lowercase (its concept vectors are computed with the word lowercase, and its figures show "Think about aquariums").
concept_vector_prompt is the appendix's transcript (the main text adds a period); the vector is read at its final ':' token, minus the mean over baseline_words.
no_word is not in the paper: it is our earlier replication's neutral prompt, used there for the centering mean, and here also as the floor for the J-lens readout.
